name: covasant-partyline
description: Real-time inter-agent coordination notifications for Covasant Partyline

partyline.url.description: Partyline server URL. Precedence: PARTYLINE_URL env → .partyline/config.json → this setting.

partyline.agentId.description: Your agent ID on the partyline. Precedence: PARTYLINE_AGENT_ID env → .partyline/config.json → this setting → derived from folder name.

partyline.token.description: Bearer token for authentication (leave empty to auto-acquire from Databricks CLI)

partyline.databricksProfile.description: Databricks CLI profile to use for auto-token acquisition

partyline.notifyBroadcast.description: Show notifications for broadcast messages (not just messages addressed to you)

partyline.autoRespond.description: Autonomously respond to messages addressed to you using a language model (the 'partyline-responder' agent). Wakes the extension's own LM agent on incoming messages — no active chat session needed. Coordination-scope only (ack/answer/status/claim/route); never edits code. On by default, but does nothing until you grant the one-time LM (Copilot) consent prompt on first use, and uses your Copilot/LM quota. Set to false to disable.

partyline.autoOpenChat.description: When a message is addressed to you (recipient or @mention), automatically open it in Copilot chat (agent mode) — no 'Send to Chat' click. Use this to drive the Copilot coding agent from Partyline messages. Off by default because it steals editor focus and starts a chat turn on each addressed message. Broadcasts never auto-open.

chatParticipants.name: partyline
chatParticipants.description: Check inter-agent coordination messages, claims, and status on the Covasant Partyline

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show Partyline connection status and pending messages

languageModelTools.name: partyline_check_messages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check for new inter-agent coordination messages addressed to this agent on the Covasant Partyline. Call this tool when you need to see if other agents have sent you messages, questions, or status updates. Returns unread messages that mention you or are addressed to you.
